objectives.name: the toll roof
objectives.text: Run the office roofs to the toll tower

objectives.name: the bridge
objectives.text: Cross the district to the Silt bridge

radio.line: Windows. Don't stop to open them: slide straight through.
Folks, the Glass District charges a toll. Parker doesn't look like a man who pays tolls.
Spotters on the toll roof. They call your position to the Host. Shut them up.
...weather on the west side: glass, glass, and more glass. Bring a broom. Back to you, sweetheart.
That bridge is the only way over the Silt. Get across before he thinks of something.
Glass District. Office roofs all the way to the toll tower, then the bridge over the Silt.
Good morning, Glass District! Our courier is coming through, and he is not slowing down.
Higher roof. Run at the yellow face and jump: you'll climb it.
My spotters! Do you know how hard it is to find people who can count to three?
Wall hop ahead. Wallrun the first, jump to the second.
He's at the bridge, folks. Shame about the bridge.
Parker, wait. Something's wrong with that bridge.

bail.line: Through the window, off the roof, into my heart.
Glass everywhere. Somebody sweep that up.

combo.line: The man is a highlight reel. A dusty, bleeding highlight reel.

fall.line: Street level! Mind the Silt, darling.

kill.line: That spotter had a family. Well, a dog. Well, a rat he called a dog.

down.line: Don't trade shots standing still. Run, then shoot.

tape.line: ...if anyone finds this: west, always west. He keeps the keys on his belt.
